notes: Speed Queen TR3 top-load washer with a belt and a variable-speed 1 HP motor. The parts manual also covers sibling suffixes (TW02, 115 and 119 variants) whose parts differ in places, and the mixing valve and out-of-balance switch change at a serial number, so check the serial plate before ordering.

gaps: Volts, amps and watts are left blank: the parts list gives part numbers only, and the spec sheet gives horsepower.

The variable-speed 1 HP wording is from the spec sheet (TR3003WN column); the parts list gives the motor's part number only. Whether the motor is AC or DC is not given, so no ac flag is set and it is filed under motor_ac as the only motor key.
Control assembly: the draft gave 204074P, which the list assigns to the AWNE9 (TR7) group; this model's entry is 205076P, used here.
The drive control assembly 204659P is claimed as listed; what it drives is not stated.
The mixing valve is mapped to valve_solenoid by function and the lid lock kit to solenoid_actuator by function; the list does not name solenoids, and for the lid lock kit names only the bezel.
Leg spring quantity 6 is the four rear plus two front springs the list's two entries describe.
Serial changes: out-of-balance switch at 1906000001, mixing valve at 1812016077; both are given as the list states them.
method: Speed Queen spec sheet AR20-0032 (2020), hosted by AJ Madison and carrying Speed Queen's own branding; page rendered. Its Model No. row ties product code TR3003WN to AWN43RSN116TW01, and the 'Variable Speed, 1 HP Motor' row is marked under TR3, TR5 and TR7.
Alliance Laundry parts manual 204240R12, Residential and Non-Vend Topload Washers (October 2025): model list on printed p.3 includes AWN43RSN116TW01.
Printed pages used (printed page = PDF page minus 2): control assembly p.7, lid switch p.13, lid lock p.15, fill hose, mixing valve and pressure sensor p.17, motor and belt p.19.
More printed pages: washtub p.21, springs and out-of-balance switch p.23, drain pump and hoses p.25, weldment, shaft and pulley p.27, lead-in cord p.31, drive control p.39.
Drawings are images; part numbers come from the lists beside them (control assembly and drive control pages rendered and read).

comps.spec: Motor, Speed Queen part 204556P, listed for AWN43RSN116TW01. Speed Queen's spec sheet gives the TR3003WN a variable-speed 1 HP motor.
Belt, part 204690, in the motor, mounting bracket and belt section.
Drive pulley, part 204667, in the weldment, bearing, drive shaft and pulley section, with drive shaft 204901 and spline insert 29728.
Pump and bracket, part 203885, in the drain pump, drain hose and siphon break section.
Mixing valve, part 205547P through serial 1812016076, with dual filter mixing valve kit 205765 from serial 1812016077. It is listed in the same section as the fill hoses.
Fill hoses, 4 feet: part 203719 marked for hot water (red) and part 203720 marked for cold water (blue).
Drain hose, part 203588, and tub-to-pump hose, part 203560.
Pressure sensor, part 203843, listed in the fill hose and mixing valve section.
Lid switch kit, part 204696. The list gives separate screws for single and dual switches.
Lid lock kit, part 205222 (the list says it includes lid lock bezel 203643), listed under all other models than the 119 variants. A separate lid lock catch, 203573, is listed.
Out-of-balance switch assembly, part 803415 through serial 1905999999 or part 807384 from serial 1906000001.
Leg spring, part 37575, painted blue: four rear springs and two front springs. Green-painted front springs have to be replaced in pairs.
Lower bearing, part 28944RP, listed in the weldment and bearing assembly section beside weldment and bearing assembly 39253.
Stainless steel washtub kit, part 719P3, with washtub gasket 39122.
Drive control assembly, part 204659P, listed for AWN43RSN116TW01 in the drive control, wire harnesses and wires section. The control drive harness 204715 is listed beside it.

Control assembly, part 205076P, listed for AWN43RSN116TW01 in the graphic panel, control support panel and controls section for serial 1810000001 onward. Capacitive touch switch 204266 and LED display assembly 204488 are listed in the same section.
